title: Unstable Diffusion
description: Simulate elves spreading out with rotating directional priority rules.
writeup:
## Approach

Store elf positions in a set. Each round: elves with no neighbors stay put. Others propose a move by checking N, S, W, E (in rotating priority order) for three adjacent empty cells. If only one elf proposes a destination, it moves.

## Part 1

After 10 rounds, count empty tiles in the bounding rectangle of all elf positions.

## Part 2

Continue until no elf moves. Return the round number. The direction priority rotates each round, ensuring elves eventually spread out enough to stop.
